scripts.code-health:audit: mkdir -p artifacts/code-health/one-time-cleanup && pnpm code-health:knip && pnpm code-health:jscpd && pnpm code-health:go
scripts.code-health:go: mkdir -p artifacts/code-health/one-time-cleanup && sh -c 'cd server && GOENV_VERSION=1.26.1 golangci-lint run ./... --timeout 5m || { echo "golangci-lint failed; falling back to GOENV_VERSION=1.26.1 go test ./..."; GOENV_VERSION=1.26.1 go test ./...; }' > artifacts/code-health/one-time-cleanup/go-audit.txt 2>&1 || true
scripts.code-health:jscpd: mkdir -p artifacts/code-health/one-time-cleanup && jscpd apps packages server scripts --config .jscpd.json --exit-code 0
